name: Correct Craft
subsector: recreational boat and marine engine group
desc: Orlando-based holding company of recreational boat brands, marine engines and boat technology, including Nautique, Centurion, Bass Cat and Indmar.

marketing_autonomy_basis: Operating holding company with its own brands and management

markets: Mainly United States, with dealer distribution abroad (e.g. Japan via Suzuki historically)
